Species disclosure
  This model is a JAGUAR. No leopard model under CC0 or CC BY that could be
  downloaded without an account was found, so the jaguar, which has a very
  similar rosette coat, stands in for the leopard in this simulation. It must
  not be described as a leopard model.

Changes made (CC BY requires changes to be indicated)
  - Converted from GLB to FBX in Blender 5.2.
  - Scaled uniformly and moved so the feet rest on the ground at the origin.
  - Base colour texture extracted from the GLB and downscaled from
    2048 x 2048 to 1024 x 1024.
  - Material renamed. No change to the mesh shape or the coat pattern.

Retrieved 13 October 2026.
